criteria.text: The baseline identifies the exact checkout and relevant local modifications without leaking secrets.
The pilot scope distinguishes proposed, confirmed, unsupported and unresolved entries; external approvals are not fabricated.
All 24 prompts and roadmap R01–R12 are accounted for in a dependency-aware register; no deployment or customer-readiness claim is made.
A repeated finalized operation counts once; a reversal is explicit; a failed or uncertain operation is not reported as completed.
Cross-tenant reads are denied; no sensitive customer/payroll/provider payload enters analytics.
Demo/jobs are excluded from human adoption; missing or immature observations never become inferred churn.
One working measurement slice and documented remaining instrumentation exist, or a concrete architecture blocker is recorded without building a speculative warehouse.
Fixture source counts, quantities, values and control totals reconcile with no unexplained difference.
Tests expose a duplicated opening posting and a ledger imbalance rather than making the generated expected values mirror implementation.
The ownership map names existing services, missing paths and explicit reviewer requirements; it does not invent approved accounting mappings.
The trust matrix maps every pilot path to server authority and a specific denial case.
Any changed authority boundary has focused regression evidence and no client-supplied tenant trust.
The recovery protocol identifies database, files and operational dependencies; the roadmap’s proposed 15-minute RPO/4-hour RTO are not reported as achieved.
Missing deployment evidence is explicit and cannot unlock live onboarding.
Identical replay produces one set of financial/stock effects and returns the original confirmed outcome.
Changed payload and unauthorized tenant/location attempts are rejected consistently.
Uncertain state remains recoverable without duplicate sale or forced cart reset.
Mocks and actual transaction/concurrency evidence are reported separately; the zero-tax fixture does not certify tax behavior.
Replay into sale commit cannot double-post; changed payload/invalid authority is denied.
Restart/reconnect preserves pending operations on the tested device and makes unknown status visible.
Expired/revoked policy has a defined operator path; no silent drop or false paid state.
Supported envelope and untested combinations are documented.
A user can import synthetic masters and see the exact remaining opening-position steps.
Masters success does not mark opening stock, AR/AP or accounting complete.
Wrong-tenant and unauthorized/reviewer-self-approval attempts are denied according to current controls.
FR/EN and loading/empty/error/recovery states are usable in the tested view.
Cashier can find and execute the supported recovery action without losing the operation identity.
Manager can trace a discrepancy to its source and next permitted action; source unavailability is explicit.
No unauthorized action is exposed by optimistic UI; all mutations remain server-authorized.
Record actual FR/EN renderings, keyboard/focus and representative viewport behavior; list untested accessibility claims.
Every pilot data category is included, explicitly excluded with reason, or a named blocker.
The independent fixture check detects omitted referenced evidence and mismatched totals/hashes.
Secrets and access tokens are excluded; customer-owned sensitive fields require explicit authorized archive scope.
Current AP row/size limits and redacted reports are recorded as implementation constraints, not retention benefits.
Each lifecycle transition has an owner, trigger, business effect, data-access effect and recovery path.
Cancellation does not require feedback and does not intentionally trap data.
Read-only/export policy and unsupported stop behavior have explicit resolutions or blockers.
Policies and prices awaiting owner/legal review are clearly proposed; no inferred approval appears in UI or code.
Implemented, tested, expert-reviewed and live-supported statuses remain separate for every capability.
Accounting regime and national obligations are unresolved until appropriate review exists.
Generic HMAC ingestion is not labeled a native live connector; sandbox is not labeled production.
The packet names missing inputs and owners without contacting providers, authorities or customers.
Every first-month acceptance item is PASS, PARTIAL, BLOCKED or NOT_RUN with evidence and owner.
M0 passes only if its required scope/baseline/fixture/owner artifacts exist and unresolved limitations are explicit.
No Gate A or paid-launch claim is made from a preparation checkpoint.
Each unfinished task has the exact next action and dependency; no silent carryover or optimistic calendar assumption.
M1 fixtures reconcile quantities, valuation, AR/AP control totals and balanced ledger with zero unexplained differences.
Duplicate/retry/concurrent requests cannot double-post; changed payload and self-approval are denied.
Rejected rows can be repaired and retried without corrupting accepted rows; original source provenance remains.
Applicable accounting mappings have qualified review for live use; missing review blocks that claim.
M2 proves recoverable operations with no duplicate/missing effects across the declared fixture.
M3 manager task resolves a controlled discrepancy with evidence and reviewer decision retained.
Receiving proof is not misreported as AP payment-release proof; recording payment evidence is not labeled transfer execution.
Unsupported tenders/devices/operations remain explicit.
A synthetic issue can be assigned, explained, reviewed and traced in the pack without unauthorized disclosure.
Revoked/expired/read-only grants enforce their exact capabilities on actions and downloads.
A later source change cannot silently preserve stale current-proof status.
Synthetic close proof is labeled rehearsal; real accepted M4 requires actual authorized reviewer evidence.
Manifest completeness and omissions match the promised scope; no unresolved missing attachment/reference is hidden.
Independent reconstruction reconciles counts and financial/stock control totals.
Interrupted generation resumes safely; unauthorized/revoked requests and expired links are denied.
M5 technical proof is distinct from production tenant-export evidence and commercial policy approval.
A performed restore is evidenced with sanitized target identity, timestamps, checks and exact scope; local proof is not production readiness.
No restored queue duplicates financial work; access and attachment checks pass.
Supported lifecycle scenarios agree with the resolved P10 policy; missing authority is blocked rather than guessed.
Incident/runbook owner and safe pause/recovery steps are concrete.
Gate A is PASS only with required S/M/D/B and applicable expert/operational evidence; unknown or skipped required checks block it.
No provider or payroll capability enters the envelope without its own evidence.
Pilot packet has task scripts, stopping conditions, recovery contacts/roles and data-access plan.
Gate decision does not claim pilot execution or authorize deployment/customer contact by itself.
